page.layout: One column of text, with indented sub-items in the same column. Below the text: the catchword and the gathering signature. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: α. Ab injusto ad finem suum consequendum studio; per conquisitionem thesaurorum ex pudendo quaestu coacervandorum
β. A fastuoso laboris scopo; ut se supra manum potentum elevet.
ɔ[?] Malum in genere indicatur sub particulâ comminatoriâ, VÆ.
II. Alloquitur ad illum pseudoeconomum, cui
N. Pudendum suum consilium objicit ut culpandum verf. 10.
β. A modo prosequendi finem suum per tyrannidem
ɔ[?] Oppositionem decretam ad ejus refrænationem denunciat; & quidem ab iis exspectandam, qui partes faciebant domus, quam aedificabat. verf. 11.

§. 3. Parabola molimen architectonicum exponit, cujus consilium gravissimas ab causas ita Deo judici displicet, ut velit ex certâ quâdam indignatione illud fabricanti vertere in pudorem; & aliquando ad eorum querelas, qui partem faciebant domus istius, eludere.

page.notes: The symbols before "α", "β" and the third item are printed as small ornaments; the third symbol is read as ɔ[?] and may be a different sign (a stylised 3 or Ɔ). The "N." openers are printed in a decorated letter and are read as N. The "11" after "verf." of the last paragraph is partly faint. The page number 411 is printed at the head right and is read as 411.
